title: Nutrition tubes — a fair comparison
question: Same component, three views: the image, the built widget lifted out of the app onto a similar ground, and the built widget where it sits today. The CSS check found nothing in the app overriding it; what changes between the second and third card is the screen around it.

options.label: The image
options.thesis: Frosted capsules on a soft lavender-peach light.

options.label: Built, on its own
options.thesis: The app's own component, lifted out of the screen, at the image's size and ground.
options.viewport: Remaining gaps: the typeface (Assistant, the app's face), coloured values instead of grey, and the app's colours instead of the image's.
options.risk: Each of those is a small, named fix.

options.label: Built, in today's screen
options.thesis: The same component inside the old nutrition screen: night sky, purple header and tabs, a purple + floating over it.
options.risk: Fixed by designing the whole nutrition screen, not by changing the widget.
